priorities.summary: Unauthenticated network attacker can compromise Oracle Access Manager's Authentication Engine via HTTP; scope-change allows full read/write/delete of critical data. Versions 12.2.1.4.0 and 14.1.2.1.0 affected; patch in Oracle's October 2026 CPU.

Easily exploitable unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in Oracle E-Business Suite's Application Object Library (AppsTCFServer servlet) resulting in full takeover of the component. Versions 12.2.3–12.2.15 affected; patch in Oracle's October 2026 CPU.

A subset of Rank Math SEO PRO 3.0.123 packages downloaded Oct 15–16 shipped with embedded malware: self-restoring PHP backdoors, rogue admin accounts, and credential theft via an external C2. Sites that activated affected packages must treat themselves as compromised; 3.0.124 is the clean replacement.

model.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
model.summary: MiniMax's 428B-parameter MoE text model (23B active) with 1M-token context and always-on reasoning across five effort levels, delivering ~3x faster inference and ~70% lower agentic-task costs than M3 at flat $0.15/$0.60 per million tokens; the anonymous "Space Bunny" checkpoint was an early build, and open weights are promised Oct 23.
